phases.objective: Bind every local Windows Staging deployment, recovery, certification, and health readback to the same TunnelMode-selected Compose topology and preserve a single-object certification result under strict PowerShell semantics.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: AutoPilot runs with TunnelMode=windows_service or TunnelMode=docker_sidecar.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Deployment, post-convergence app refresh, certification, and health monitoring all resolve the identical Compose override; certification returns one state object and missing status evidence blocks with a typed contract failure.
steps: Resolve base and Staging Compose files for every tunnel mode.
Add the Windows service port-publication override for windows_service mode.
Add the Docker sidecar override for docker_sidecar mode.
Use the selected topology for build, up, health, convergence refresh, certification, and monitoring.
Normalize empty, one-item, and multi-item certification failure fields as arrays before Count evaluation.
Route certification subprocess text to the host stream and return exactly one state object.
Fail closed with certification_contract_invalid when certification_status is absent.
assertions: Windows service mode publishes the loopback origin required by the Staging Cloudflared service.
Docker sidecar mode retains its dedicated Compose topology.
No deployment or evidence path silently falls back to base-plus-Staging Compose files after a tunnel mode is selected.
StrictMode cannot turn an empty certification failure set into a Count property exception.
Production deployment, DNS mutation, database mutation, migration apply, and secrets output remain false.
